source.base_task: I want to learn computer programming skills on Coursera. Could you please recommend a course related to programming and algorithms (i.e., with skill tag computer programming), as well as a Python-related course (i.e., with skill tag Python programming), both offered by UK universities and with a rating of 4.5 or higher? Please provide the homepage links for these courses on Coursera.

i0.content: Find Computer Programming courses on Coursera that are offered by UK universities.

revisions.content: Only keep courses rated 4.5 or higher.
Recommend one programming-and-algorithms course and one Python-programming course from these. Give the Coursera homepage link for each.

milestones.semantic_concept: The Coursera search for Computer Programming courses offered by UK universities is established.
The 4.5-or-higher rating criterion is in effect on the UK Computer Programming course search.

constraints.description: One selected course must have the Computer Programming skill (programming and algorithms)
Selected courses must be offered by UK universities
Each selected course must be rated 4.5 or higher
The final answer must identify two distinct matching courses (one programming-and-algorithms, one Python-programming) and include a Coursera homepage link for each
